title: 第九章 冷眼观局善恶不再留余地第十章 罡风炼骨绝境无柔唯杀伐
lines: 演武场的风，许久未曾平息。
尘土被气流卷动，缓缓落定，如同彻底崩塌的三房威严，再也无法重回往日的盛势。全场死寂，无数道目光死死落在场中那道青衫身影上，敬畏、惊惧、复杂百般的情绪交织缠绕，压得整片场地鸦雀无声。
沈浩瘫倒在地，胸口塌陷一片，衣衫染满猩红，气息微弱紊乱，整个人如同被抽走了所有筋骨与傲气。他抬起头，浑浊的眼底盛满极致的恐惧与怨毒，再也没有了往日嫡系天骄的骄矜跋扈。
一招。
彻彻底底的碾压。
同为淬体六重，他坐拥三房海量资源、名师指点、高阶功法滋养，自出世以来便稳居同辈顶端，从未将落魄旁支的沈砚放在眼中。可今日，他在所有人面前，被自己轻视践踏了整整十年的人，亲手打碎了所有骄傲与依仗。
最让他绝望的，从不是战败的屈辱，而是沈砚方才眼底那片毫无温度的漠然。
那不是同辈相争的狠厉，不是积怨爆发的报复，而是看待死人的冰冷与淡漠。
方才沈砚掌停他咽喉一寸之时，他清晰地感受到，对方心中没有半分迟疑，没有半分顾虑，唯有绝对的杀伐决断。若非时机未到、刻意隐忍，他此刻早已是一具冰冷的尸体。
赵坤僵在原地，浑身冷汗浸透后背，先前的厉声呵斥、规矩压制尽数烟消云散。他死死盯着从容伫立的沈砚，心底掀起惊涛骇浪，一股前所未有的恐慌彻底笼罩心神。
他追随三房多年，见惯了世家倾轧、人心算计，自认深谙权谋博弈、看人精准，却从未看透沈砚。
十年蛰伏，沉默寡言，任打任压，不争不抢，所有人都以为他是懦弱无能、天生卑微，是可以随意揉捏、肆意践踏的蝼蚁。
可直到今日他才彻底醒悟，那不是懦弱，那是隐忍蓄势；那不是无能，那是藏锋守拙。
此人蛰伏十年，心性早已磨砺得深沉如海，理智近乎冰冷，杀伐绝不拖泥带水，既能绝境搏杀、以弱逆强，又能审时度势、收放自如。凶性起时可斩尽杀绝，理智存时可隐忍布局。
这般心境、城府、战力，根本不是十五岁少年该有的模样。
三房，这是养虎为患，亲手纵容出了一个足以颠覆整个三房根基的绝世隐患。
沈砚无视全场百态，目光平静扫过倒地的沈浩与失态的赵坤，周身气息澄澈冷冽，无半分波澜。
他没有胜利者的张扬得意，也没有积怨得报的快意，只剩一片通透的冷静。
从昨夜荒山三死士伏杀的那一刻，他心中对侯府、对三房、对同族亲情的最后一丝期盼，便彻底寸寸碎裂，荡然无存。
从前他退让、隐忍、克制，是尚留一丝念想，盼世道公允、盼宗族留情、盼人心存善。
如今他彻底看清，世家博弈从无温情，弱小便有罪，崛起便是过错，退让只会换来步步紧逼，隐忍只会招来赶尽杀绝。
既然世间善恶不分、规矩不公，那他便自己立心、自己立界、自己掌分寸。
慈悲锁心，不再对外敌半分流露；锋芒随身，从此遇恶便斩、逢敌不退。
“沈砚！你大胆！”
良久，赵坤才强行压下心底惊惧，鼓起残存的底气厉声怒斥，声音却依旧发颤，“演武堂切磋，你下手狠辣，重伤同族，无视府规，目无尊卑！今日之事，绝不能轻易揭过！随我去前厅，面见族老，听候发落！”
他已然看出，当场对峙、武力压制已然行不通，沈砚战力超绝、气场慑人，再硬碰硬只会自取其辱。唯一的破局之法，便是搬出族老规矩、搬出宗族权势，用整个侯府的制度体系，强行镇压沈砚。
这是三房最后的依仗，也是柳氏早已备好的后手。
暗杀不成、明战惨败，便借宗族规矩定罪，以“重伤同族、扰乱家风、狂妄悖逆”的罪名，将沈砚重罚囚禁、废除修为，彻底永绝后患。
沈砚闻言，唇角微抬，勾起一抹冰冷淡笑。
果然如此。
他早已料到三房的后手。柳氏心思缜密、步步为营，从不会做无把握之局，明棋暗棋层层嵌套，暗杀是暗手，宗族定罪便是明手，一阴一阳，双管齐下，誓要将他彻底碾碎。
可今日的沈砚，早已不再是任人拿捏、无力反抗的蝼蚁。
他掌心微微一动，三枚死士令牌与淬毒短刀稳稳落在手中，光泽清晰，纹路确凿，铁证如山，无可抵赖。
“听候发落？”沈砚声音清冷，穿透全场死寂，字字铿锵，“赵执事不妨先告知族老，昨夜是谁私遣嫡系死士，深夜伏杀宗族子弟，欲置我于死地？”
“是谁视府规如无物，暗蓄死士、私动杀局，残害同族、践踏家风？”
“我身陷必死之局，绝地求生、反手自保，何错之有？沈浩当众寻衅、出手偷袭、欲伤我性命，我被动反击、适度惩戒，又何罪之有？”
三连质问，层层递进，句句诛心，堵得赵坤面色惨白、哑口无言，所有预设的说辞、定罪的理由，瞬间尽数崩塌。
content_en:
The wind in the martial arts arena has not calmed down for a long time.
The dust was swept up by the airflow and slowly settled, like the majesty of the three houses that had completely collapsed and could never regain its former glory. The whole place was dead silent, and countless eyes were fixed on the green-shirted figure in the field. Awe, fear, and complex emotions were intertwined, and the whole place was filled with silence.
Shen Hao collapsed to the ground, his chest collapsed, his clothes were stained with scarlet, his breath was weak and disordered, and it was as if all the muscles, bones and pride had been taken away from his whole body. He raised his head, and his cloudy eyes were filled with extreme fear and resentment. He no longer had the arrogance and domineering look of his direct lineage.
One move.
Complete crushing.
Both are at the sixth level of body tempering. He has the vast resources of the third room, the guidance of famous teachers, and the nourishment of high-level skills. He has been firmly at the top of his peers since he was born, and has never looked down upon the downcast Shen Yan. But today, in front of everyone, he personally shattered all the pride and reliance of the person he had despised and trampled on for ten years.
What made him despair the most was never the humiliation of defeat, but the temperatureless indifference in Shen Yan's eyes just now.
It was not the fierce rivalry between peers, nor the revenge caused by the outbreak of grudges, but the coldness and indifference towards the dead.
When Shen Yan's palm stopped just an inch from his throat, he clearly felt that there was no hesitation or concern in the other party's heart, only the absolute decision to kill. If it hadn't been for the lack of opportunity and deliberate forbearance, he would have been a cold corpse at this moment.
Zhao Kun froze on the spot, his back soaked with cold sweat. All the previous harsh words and rules and suppression had disappeared. He stared intently at Shen Yan, who was standing calmly, feeling a turmoil in his heart, and an unprecedented panic completely enveloped his mind.
He has followed Sanfang for many years, and is used to seeing the strife and scheming of wealthy families. He thinks he is well versed in the game of power and can read people accurately, but he has never seen through Shen Yan.
After ten years of dormancy, silent, willing to be beaten and pressured, neither fighting nor grabbing, everyone thought that he was weak and incompetent, born to be humble, an ant that could be kneaded and trampled on at will.
But it wasn't until today that he finally realized that that was not cowardice, that was holding back and gathering strength; that was not incompetence, that was hiding one's strength.
This person has been dormant for ten years, and his mind has been honed to a depth as deep as the sea. His rationality is almost as cold as ice. When the ferocity arises, one can kill them all, but when rationality persists, one can tolerate the layout.
Such a state of mind, city, and fighting power are simply not what a fifteen-year-old boy should look like.
Sanfang, this is a recipe for trouble, and he has personally connived at a hidden danger that is enough to subvert the foundation of the entire Sanfang.
Shen Yan ignored the various expressions in the audience, and his eyes calmly swept over Shen Hao who fell to the ground and Zhao Kun who was losing his composure. The aura around him was clear and cold, without any ripples.
He didn't have the arrogant pride of a winner, nor the joy of having his grudges repaid, only a clear calmness.
From the moment when the three dead men were ambushed in the barren mountain last night, the last glimmer of hope in his heart for the Marquis Mansion, for his third wife, and for the family ties of his clan had been completely shattered and gone.
In the past, he gave in, tolerated, and restrained, but he still had a trace of hope that the world would be fair, that the family would be merciful, and that people would be kind.
Now he clearly sees clearly that there is no tenderness in family games, weakness is guilty, rising is the fault, giving in will only lead to pressing harder, and forbearance will only lead to extermination.
Since there is no distinction between good and evil in the world, and the rules are unfair, he has to set his own mind, establish his own boundaries, and control his own boundaries.
Compassion locks the heart, and no longer reveals it to external enemies; the edge is always with you, and from now on, you will kill when you encounter evil, and never retreat when you encounter enemies.
"Shen Yan! You are brave!"
After a long time, Zhao Kun suppressed the fear in his heart and mustered up the remaining confidence to scream angrily, but his voice was still trembling, "During the competition in the martial arts hall, you were ruthless and severely injured your fellow clansmen. You ignored the rules of the government and showed no respect! What happened today must not be revealed easily! Follow me to the front hall, meet the clan elders, and wait for your punishment!"
He has already seen that confrontation on the spot and suppression by force are no longer feasible. Shen Yan has extraordinary combat power and awe-inspiring aura. Any more head-on confrontation will only bring humiliation to himself. The only way to break the situation is to move out of the clan's old rules, move out the clan's power, and use the entire system of the Marquis Mansion to forcibly suppress Shen Yan.
This is Sanfang's last resort, and it is also the back-up that Liu has already prepared.
When the assassination attempt failed and the Ming Dynasty was defeated miserably, they used clan rules to convict Shen Yan. He was charged with "severely injuring his fellow clan members, disrupting family tradition, and being arrogant and rebellious."
When Shen Yan heard this, he raised the corners of his lips slightly, revealing a cold smile.
Sure enough.
He had already anticipated Sanfang's back-up plan. Mr. Liu is meticulous and careful at every step. He will never make an uncertain move. His overt and dark moves are nested layer by layer. The assassination is a secret move, and the clan's conviction is an open move. One yin and one yang, two-pronged approach, vowing to crush him completely.
But today's Shen Yan is no longer an ant who is at the mercy of others and unable to resist.
He moved his palm slightly, and the three Death Soldier tokens and the poison-quenching dagger fell steadily into his hands. The luster was clear, the lines were conclusive, and the evidence was irrefutable.
"Are you ready to die?" Shen Yan's voice was cold and cold, penetrating the dead silence of the whole place, and every word was sonorous, "Deacon Zhao might as well tell the clan elders first, who secretly sent his direct relatives to die last night to ambush the clan's children late at night, intending to kill me?"
"Who treats government regulations as if they are nothing, secretly prepares dead soldiers, launches private killings, harms fellow clan members, and tramples on family traditions?"
"I am in a certain death situation. I am desperate to survive and protect myself. What is wrong with me? Shen Hao provoked me in public, launched a sneak attack, and tried to hurt my life. I passively fought back and punished me appropriately. What is wrong with me?"
Three consecutive questionings, one after another, each sentence was heart-breaking, until Zhao Kun turned pale and became speechless. All the preset rhetoric and reasons for conviction collapsed in an instant.
title_en: Chapter 9: Looking at the situation with a cold eye, leaving no room for good and evil. Chapter 10: Gangfeng bone refining, desperate situation, no mercy but killing.
